question: Labrador Sea and Mediterranean Sea are part of the:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Atlantic Ocean.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Labrador sea is a part of the North Atlantic Ocean__.

 
 
• The Atlantic Ocean is the second-largest ocean of the world.
 
• The Labrador sea is between the Labrador Peninsula and Greenland.
 
• It is connected with Baffin Bay in the north through the Davis Strait and with Hudson Bay in the west through Hudson Strait.
 
• It contains one of the world's largest turbidity current channel systems, the Northwest Atlantic Mid-Ocean Channel.
 
 
 
• The Mediterranean Sea is an intercontinental sea that stretches from the Atlantic Ocean on the west to Asia on the east and separates Europe from Africa.
 
 
• Calypso Deep, located in the Hellenic Trench, Ionian Sea southwest of Pylos, Greece, is the deepest part of the Mediterranean Sea, with a maximum depth of 5,267 m.
 
• The Mediterranean Sea extends for about 4,000 km (west to east) from the Strait of Gibraltar to the Gulf of Iskenderun on Turkey's southwestern coast.
